idUniqueness.details: No duplicate IDs across each source/case/label/learner/question collection.

evidenceClassSeparation.details: Measured, material-characterisation, simulation, literature, downstream-proxy, learner-proxy and synthetic sources remain non-equivalent.

findings.finding: Discovery access status was too optimistic for canonical use.
findings.evidence: 43/75 discovery entries have no explicit licence field in the accumulated manifest; several sources already have stricter repository outcomes (blank licence, mirror-rights unresolved, retrieval blocked, embargoed or special-format blocked).
findings.impact: Treating public/downloadable as reusable could create rights violations and inflated evidence counts.
findings.remediation: Discovery metadata is staged only; canonical repository rights/retrieval decisions override the accumulated manifest.

findings.evidence: 90 provenance records existed for 120 case/label/learner/question artifacts; LABEL-006..015, LEARN-PROXY-006..015 and MDQ-061..070 were missing.
findings.impact: Untraceable validation evidence and assessment content.

findings.finding: 40 draft assessment items embed exact values from a restricted research/education dataset.
findings.evidence: 24 real-cycle classification + 16 pairwise items were built from exact iGuzzini CSV rows. Canonical repository governance says raw redistribution is disallowed.
findings.impact: Committing full item text could leak/repackage restricted raw source values and contaminate holdout evaluation.
findings.remediation: All 40 are represented by ID and source linkage but content is withheld; promotion remains blocked pending rights review or regeneration from redistribution-safe aggregates.

findings.finding: All 70 added questions are psychometrically uncalibrated.
findings.evidence: No real MouldMaster learner response rows exist.
findings.remediation: Keep as candidates; collect privacy-safe telemetry and promote only after item-quality thresholds pass.

findings.finding: 20 material datasets are evidence sources, not exact-grade material-catalog records.
findings.evidence: They do not satisfy material-grade-v2 required identity, lifecycle, publisher source-document, retrieval date and fingerprint fields as currently represented.
findings.impact: Direct import would mix research characterization with supplier-grade truth.
findings.remediation: Stage as research evidence; separately extract exact commercial grades only when required fields and source fingerprints are available.

findings.finding: At least 20 of the 75 discovered sources are already governed by existing repository records.
findings.evidence: Confirmed overlaps include ProBayes, SKZ LoKI, scatimdata, iGuzzini, Foxconn, RWTH PCR, FORinFPRO-HIMD, PET preform, Mendeley injection/blow, energy, Leon embargoed sets, AD-STGN, Warwick, DIC, Nylon-12 XRD, XPS and SiC/Nylon-6.
findings.impact: Naive append would double-count independent families.
findings.remediation: Crosswalk to existing canonical IDs; countAsNewIndependentFamily=false.

findings.finding: One exact source URL is duplicated across separate scenario IDs.
findings.impact: Source-count inflation if scenarios are mistaken for independent datasets.
findings.remediation: Keep scenario-level IDs but assign a shared parent/overlap family before any independence count.

findings.finding: Four source records explicitly use CC BY-NC 3.0.
findings.impact: Commercial redistribution/use requires separate legal/rights review.
findings.remediation: No raw payload or canonical commercial material promotion through this integration.

findings.finding: The synthetic/LLM-curated QA source remains in the discovery pool.
findings.evidence: MM-DATA-025 is explicitly marked low-trust synthetic.
findings.impact: Could contaminate authoritative knowledge if merged indiscriminately.
findings.remediation: Retain coverage-idea-mining-only; never count as ground truth.

automatedTestsRecommended: Research expansion IDs unique within and across artifact classes.
Every staged artifact has a provenance record.
Every question references an existing case/source and has a promotionStatus.
No item with promotionStatus=blocked-source-rights stores stem/options/rationale.
Learner proxy records must carry proxyOnly=true and never increment real learner counts.
External label sources must never increment independent MouldMaster engineer-label count.
Embargoed sources must remain non-executable until their access date and re-review.
CC BY-NC and missing-license sources cannot enter raw redistribution paths.
Canonical measured time-series count cannot change from research-expansion metadata alone.
Material research sources cannot be promoted to exact-grade catalog without material-grade-v2 validation.
